title: LookDaylight
description: Data file content/look/daylight.json: sun, moon, light and sky per time of day (B2 R22). The presentation blends between the phases (WorldTime/DayPhase, day length per season from time.json). Night stays recognisable: brightness never drops below the minimum.

night_min_brightness.description: Lowest ambient light energy in every phase (0..1): the night never turns pitch black.

sun_azimuth_deg.description: Compass direction the sunlight comes from (degrees around the vertical; the elevation comes from the phase).

phases.description: One entry per time of day (vocabulary kind time_of_day).

shadow_blur.description: Softness of the sun's shadow edges (Godot shadow blur; island scene and the main game's island mode).

tonemap.description: Tone mapping of the island's light (linear keeps the palette colours as written).

sky.description: Sky shader shared by all phases (stars and horizon at night, A1367).

moon.description: Moon disc in the sky and the moonlight; the phase's moon value blends it in.

sun_elevation_deg.description: Elevation of the sun (negative below the horizon; the moon lights the night).

moon.description: Visibility of the moon and share of moonlight in the main light (0..1).

water_light.description: Tint of the unlit water shaders (sea, fresh water, streams) as lowercase #rrggbb; #ffffff keeps the day colours.

horizon_falloff.description: Exponent of the gradient from the horizon colour to the top colour (smaller = wider light band at the horizon).

below_horizon.description: Brightness of the sky below the horizon relative to the horizon colour (keeps the horizon line readable).

star_density.description: Share of sky cells that hold a star (0..1).

star_brightness.description: Brightness of a star at full visibility (the phase's stars value scales it).

star_horizon_fade.description: Height above the horizon (0..1, sine of the elevation) over which the stars fade out towards the horizon.

elevation_deg.description: Elevation of the moon above the horizon.

azimuth_deg.description: Compass direction of the moon (degrees around the vertical, like sun_azimuth_deg).

disc_size_deg.description: Angular radius of the soft moon disc.

glow.description: Strength of the soft halo around the disc.

light_energy.description: Strength of the moonlight (it replaces the sunlight as the phase's moon value rises).

shadows.description: Whether the moonlight casts shadows (the same single light as the sun, so no extra shadow pass).
